title: Scripta Import
summary: Turns an uploaded foreign book into a scriptaWorlds universe: a bounded range of the host's extraction per turn, the book's own prose cleaned and segmented into chapters/, canon, threads and atlas derived from that prose, an import record that says how far the import has come, and a dependency-free validator the host runs after every turn without spending model budget.
outputs: chapters/NNNN-slug.md — the book's own prose, cleaned, segmented and titled, never rewritten
canon.md, threads.json and atlas.json derived from the imported chapters
drafts/import-progress.json — the import record and the machine-readable marker that this universe was imported
One JSON validation envelope on stdout from scripts/validate-import.mjs, with ok, code, errors and warnings
